title: Instagram Stories
subtitle: Let everything expire by itself, and do the fan-out work at write time only for ordinary accounts
motto: Content that dies in a day should never need a delete job
coreAddition: TTL at every layer plus hybrid fan-out
keyInsight: Fan-out on write is cheap for the average account and ruinous for a few huge ones, so the design is decided by the tail of the follower distribution, not the mean.

decisions.title: Expire with TTLs instead of a delete job
decisions.description: Object storage, metadata and feed entries each expire at 24 hours on their own, so storage stays at one day of content and no job deletes rows.
decisions.alternatives: An hourly cron delete would leave stories visible an hour late and run thousands of deletes a second.

decisions.title: Fan-out on write, with celebrities pulled at read time
decisions.description: Ordinary uploads are written into follower feeds so a read is one lookup; accounts with a million followers are merged in when the feed opens, at about 50 ms extra.
decisions.alternatives: Pure fan-out on read needs one query per followed account, and pure fan-out on write makes one celebrity upload a million writes.
